scope: finite bottom-up acceptance catalogue, not complete replacement test inventory

cases.title: Independent core build and value/codec contract
cases.acceptance: Core target builds and runs without SQL, network/server/client/RP imports; independent equality/order/NULL/version vectors

cases.title: Actual minimal substrate
cases.acceptance: Same production row/catalog API as later executor; fixture version and allocation ownership explicit; no empty-transaction-only PASS

cases.title: Private batch and failure effects
cases.acceptance: Read-your-writes, hidden uncommitted rows, statement rollback, full abort and quota ledger

cases.title: Real WAL ordering
cases.acceptance: Complete framed batch; short-write/sync uncertainty; ACK-before-sync mutant rejected; no full recovery claim

cases.title: External history and production recovery
cases.acceptance: Owned worker commit result captured by controller; crash/reopen recovers ACKed complete transactions and no partial batch

cases.title: Recovery interrupted twice
cases.acceptance: Recovery and restore interruptions preserve source and replay semantics; durable-area corruption is not silently accepted as tail

cases.title: Concurrent serializable histories
cases.acceptance: Deterministic schedules plus actual threads; conflict, lost update/write skew/phantom, old snapshot lifetime

cases.title: Checkpoint and reclamation
cases.acceptance: Reader/backup pins and retained logs safe; early-reclaim mutant rejected; restore into empty owned directory

cases.title: Rows and every secondary index
cases.acceptance: Insert/update/delete/failure atomic across row/index/catalog; scan equivalence against separate model

cases.title: DISK shared durability and capacity
cases.acceptance: Real files, common commit, allocation/reclamation and bounded buffer/locator with working set at least 4x buffer

cases.title: Partition without global/SQL
cases.acceptance: Routing/membership/row movement/local index with snapshots and failure; unique only at declared supported scope, reject unsupported table-global unique

cases.title: Transport without engine
cases.acceptance: Owned IPv4/IPv6 loopback and Unix endpoints; AXF1 stream and bounded byte/slot queues, state-specific readiness and fair accept, short I/O, shared-clock absolute deadlines, cancellation/drain and owner-drop ticket settlement, independent oracle and actual fault receipts; all C-V01–18 in comm-implementation-plan.md. SQL/commit/TLS semantics remain subsequent owner obligations.

cases.title: SQL agrees with native engine histories
cases.acceptance: Equivalent bounded SQL/native operations against real DISK; independent result/effect oracle, not only comparing two paths sharing code

cases.title: Actual client acknowledgement
cases.acceptance: Observed network reply plus WAL/reopen, cancel/session/auth and disconnect uncertainty; native ACK evidence alone insufficient

detailed_recovery_scope: L0 cases extend existing K2-K5/H1/S1 obligations; optional L1/L2 cases do not become initial-kernel prerequisites
